schema.policy_text: Read the complete agreement and classify each of the two hypotheses from operative provisions governing the receiving party's disclosure or access to Confidential Information. Entail nda-5 when an operative clause expressly permits disclosure, access, or internal sharing to at least some of the receiving party's employees; permission to a defined group such as Representatives also counts when the operative clause authorizes that group and its definition includes employees. Entail nda-7 when an operative clause permits at least one genuinely external representative class covered by the hypothesis, such as consultants, contractors, agents, attorneys, accountants, legal or financial advisers, or other professional advisers. Purpose limitations, need-to-know requirements, confidentiality duties, and similar safeguards are intrinsic qualifications on an express permission and do not prevent Entailment. By contrast, a requirement to obtain new prior consent or written authorization is not itself a standing permission for the queried recipient class. Return Contradiction when an operative clause expressly prohibits disclosure to the queried class—or, for nda-7, prohibits disclosure to third parties generally—and no operative exception independently permits a covered class; a consent-only escape does not defeat that contradiction. Return NotMentioned when neither an operative permission nor an applicable express prohibition is established. Definitions, recitals, descriptions of who may disclose information, lists of Representatives unconnected to an operative authorization, and mentions of employees or advisers merely as confidential-information subjects, responsible persons, or parties' personnel do not establish permission. Do not import safeguards or recipient classes from another agreement, and do not infer unstated roles, consent, or permissions.
schema.rationale: 直接依据完整协议的操作性披露条款进行联合法律判断，能修复旧语义读取遗漏，同时避免把定义、角色列举或保密信息中的人员名称误当成披露许可。该策略从七份训练协议中归纳许可、禁止、内在资格和新增同意条件之间的稳定区别，不依赖来源身份或训练答案。
